title: Input analysis (Context Analyzer)
description: context/input-analysis.json — classifies the user's request and records which creative elements the user provided (locked) versus which Story Forge must fill (gaps). Downstream stages must never override locked elements.

mode.description: auto: only constraints given, invent everything. idea: a premise/seed given, develop it. story: a substantive narrative given, preserve and complete it.

provided.description: Creative elements extractable from the request, keyed by element name (theme, emotion, relationship, characters, setting, conflict, metaphor, ending, premise, story_text, ...). Values are what the user gave, verbatim or lightly normalised.

locked.description: Element names from 'provided' that downstream stages must preserve, not reinvent

gaps.description: Element names Story Forge must decide itself
